name: GOOG AI Fundamental Valuation
rationale: Alphabet Inc. (GOOG) is a premier core holding representing the AI Titans pillar. TTM revenue reached $402.8B (+24.2% YoY) with $132.2B in GAAP net income (32.8% net margin). 5-year DCF yields a fair value of $350.08 (+4.4% upside vs $335.41 market price at 10% discount rate). Reverse DCF indicates the market is pricing in a 17.67% 5-year CAGR, well aligned with Google Cloud/TPU scaling and Search AI Overviews. Recommendation: MAINTAIN (Core Holding: 5.0 shares). Accumulate on dips <$262.56, trim Tier 1 at $350.08.

bear.rationale: Antitrust remedies (DOJ search revenue sharing restrictions) and AI chatbot search deflection slow core Search ad revenue. Revenue grows at 8% CAGR to $592B by Year 5. Heavy AI capex (TPUs/datacenters) and depreciation compress net margin to 26%. Exit multiple contracts to 18x utility tech multiple.
risks: DOJ antitrust ruling forcing structural changes to default search agreements (Apple Safari)
Generative AI answer engines cannibalizing high-margin commercial search queries

base.rationale: Google Cloud / Vertex AI (Gemini ecosystem) and YouTube subscription/ad monetization drive 13% 5-year CAGR to $742B. In-house custom silicon (TPU v6/v7) provides structural cost advantages over merchant GPU cloud competitors, sustaining a 30% net margin. Continuous share repurchases reduce diluted share count by 2%/yr. Exit P/E of 24x reflects wide-moat AI titan cash generator.
risks: Slower cloud margin expansion if TPU hardware supply constraints persist
Macro advertising slowdown impacting digital ad pricing

bull.rationale: Gemini Ultra multi-modal platform commands enterprise AI leadership; Google Cloud operating margins expand to 25%+. AI Overviews expand total search queries and increase commercial intent ad conversion. Revenue grows at 18% CAGR to $921B. Massive free cash flow ($150B+/yr) funds aggressive share buybacks (-2.5%/yr) and 34% net margins. Premium multiple re-rates to 28x.
risks: Intensified frontier model competition from OpenAI/Anthropic/Meta
Increased regulatory scrutiny over AI cloud bundling
